content: 0x5e/homebridge-tuya-platform (now @homebridge-plugins/homebridge-tuya): 60+ categories, Tap-to-Run scenes, per-device override config for non-standard DPs, energy kWh. BUT uses developer-project API (accessId/accessKey + app schema 'tuyaSmart'/'smartlife') - the dev-account path our project avoids. homebridge-tuya-web (abandoned) supported switch/outlet/light/dimmer/fan/cover/scene via cloud. Config UI fields: home whitelist, debug.
